parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the inventory task.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: The pagination offset. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search on knowledge content.

parameters.name: ShowType
parameters.description: The type of knowledge to retrieve. Valid values are `TABLE`, `COLUMN`, `SQL`, `SEG`, `LINEAGE`, and `TERM`.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of items per page. The default value is 20, and the maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Valid values are `confidence` and `entityId`. The default value is `confidence`.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values are `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. The default value is `desc`.
